name: retrieval
notes: Written by Claude in plan 3 step 03, before any search code existed. None were written by Karlo.

finding: a baseline finding's title (evals/results/example-app, non-smoke planted runs), word for word. Expected IDs are the MASWE and MASTG IDs of the answer key item(s) the finding was matched to, not the IDs the finding cited (some cited wrong ones, e.g. MASWE-0067 for a debuggable build).

missed: answer key issues the baseline missed in some runs, or only ever reported bundled with another issue, rewritten by Claude from the item's planted text. These know the answer key's wording, so they may flatter search more than finding queries.
id: queries that name an ID. Expected: that record (a deprecated v1 test is expected as itself).
none: questions the corpus can't answer. Expected IDs are empty; they are scored apart.
Split by item: an answer key item's queries are all in dev or all in test, so tuning on dev can't learn a test item's words. Exceptions: none.
A hit is any expected record, whatever its kind. Chunk IDs count as their record.
